newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate up to 11.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate up to 11.5 pct.

text.p: The Croatian average lending rate rose 10 basis points to 11.5 percent on Thursday despite higher supply of kuna funds on Zagreb's money market.
Dealers said total trade fell to 15.6 million kuna from Wednesday's 37 million, leaving some five million surplus on the supply side.
Fresh borrowings totalling 10.5 million kuna were mostly call money granted at a steady 11 percent. A total of 5.2 million kuna old loans were rolled over at 12 and 15 percent.
The central bank calculated its kuna midrate for Friday weaker at 5.6123 against the dollar and at 3.5613 versus the German mark.
